verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own product page says Pipelines can run CI/CD on hosted runners, private runners or both, with centralized visibility across pipeline status, testing policies and deployment environments. That matches every element of the story, but the only source is a marketing-page claim. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on private runner setup and the visibility dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can run pipelines on platform-hosted runners or my own private runners with centralized visibility

citations.quote: Run CI/CD workflows across your organization using hosted or private runners—or both, with centralized visibility across pipeline status, testing policies, deployment environments and more, no infrastructure needed.
Use our built-in CI/CD tool, Bitbucket Pipelines, to create powerful, automated workflows.
